title: AYZEN Feature Circuit
description: Phase 03. One entry per production feature in infrastructure/platform/feature-circuits.json, mapping it across the target universal circuit (roadmap section 4: Feature -> Sub-feature -> Function -> Module -> API -> Gateway -> Identity/Auth -> Policy -> Service -> Data/DB -> Outbox -> EventBus -> Workflow -> Worker -> Scheduler -> Notification -> Audit -> Telemetry -> Intelligence -> Recovery -> Lifecycle -> Artifact/Deployment -> Runtime Graph -> Enforcement Gate). Not every stage is populated for every feature yet -- requiredStages are the ones the current source registries (Phase 01 component registry, endpoint registry, event catalog) can actually populate; the rest are tracked as optional until a later phase (Workflow Recovery Contract, Event Operations Plane, Observability Completeness Gate, ...) produces that data.

componentId.description: The matching Phase 01 component registry id (kind: 'feature'), e.g. 'feature:finance.post-transaction'. Null when this circuit was auto-derived from the endpoint/event registries and has no curated Phase 01 feature component yet -- a missing-edge finding, not a schema violation, since the whole point of the registry is to surface that gap.

policy.description: Policy/permission id this route or event is gated on.

service.description: Owning service, matches a Phase 01 'service' kind component.

event.description: Event type published, when this circuit is event-driven.

audit.description: 'none' is a valid, explicit value -- distinct from an unset/unknown audit stage.

stages.description: Which universal-circuit stage names this entry actually has data for.
